names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 31 octombrie, «Sfântul Apostol Amplie».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 31 Οκτωβρίου, «Άγιοι Στάχυς, Απελλής, Αμπλίας, Ουρβανός, Νάρκισσος και Αριστόβουλος οι Απόστολοι από τους Εβδομήκοντα», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the title on his name link behind the line for 31 октября ст. ст., «Святитель Амплий, епископ Лиддский, апостол от 70-ти, сщмч.», with the rank words and the see left off. **The link's see is Lydda where the life's is Diospolis**, which are two names of one city; the folder keeps the Diospolis the other two calendars gave it. The line itself declines the name, «Амплия».

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 31. октобар ст. ст., „Св. апостоли: Стахије, Амплије, Урван, Наркис, Апелије и Аристовул.“ — «Св. апостоли» is "holy" plus the `apostle` grade, and the other five names are the heading’s other members, so the bare personal name is the whole of the form. The two names of his see, «у Лиди, или Диоспољу Јудејском», are in the body and one of them is already the folder’s `office`. `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM`.

feast.note: The Greek and Romanian calendars keep the same six apostles on their own 31 October; this is the Russian calendar's own day and not a second day on one calendar.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 31 октября ст. ст. — «Апп. от 70-ти Стахия , Амплия , Урвана , Наркисса , Апеллия и Аристовула (I).»
source.note: The line is the first of the day. The day carries one typikon sign only, «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком», so no rank is recorded.

attestations.note: The Russian agrees with the see the other two calendars gave him, «Святой Амплий был епископом в городе Диосполе», and adds two things: that he held it with the blessing of the Apostle Andrew the First-Called, and **who killed him**. The sentence of the death is plural and follows the sentence that names him and Urban together — «Святительствовали они также с благословения святого апостола Андрея. За проповедь Евангелия были преданы мученической смерти иудеями и эллинами-язычниками» — so it is the two of them who were given over to a martyr's death by Jews and by Greek pagans, for the preaching of the Gospel. The folder's `hieromartyr` was already there from the other calendars; what is new is the hands. His name link titles him «сщмч.» as well.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 31ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιοι Στάχυς, Απελλής, Αμπλίας, Ουρβανός, Νάρκισσος και Αριστόβουλος οι Απόστολοι από τους Εβδομήκοντα»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 31 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the man is the folder's own, one of the six apostles of the Seventy kept together on this day, put to death with Urban for pulling down the idols. **One disagreement is recorded and not resolved**: this page makes him «επίσκοπος Οδυσσουπόλεως» where the folder's `office` says Bishop of Diospolis. The office is left as the folder has it, the Greek page's see is written into the life, and the report names it. No year, so the folder's dateless state is unchanged. Both hymns name all six and are taken into all six folders. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 13.11.2025 (31. октобар ст. ст.) — „Св. апостоли: Стахије, Амплије, Урван, Наркис, Апелије и Аристовул.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, second of the six apostles it enumerates. THE HEADING ENUMERATES SIX APOSTLES — «Стахије, Амплије, Урван, Наркис, Апелије и Аристовул» — the largest company in this six-day block, so the brief’s enumeration ruling makes it one folder per named member and all the rows quote the whole heading. FIVE of the six take a row here. THE SIXTH, Аристовул, TAKES NOTHING: `aristobulus-of-britain` already carries a venerated serbian row on the Julian 16 March out of this same book AND already holds the Serbian form «Аристовул», so section 1 makes him report-only. «Св. апостоли» is the `apostle` grade all six folders already hold and the body’s «Од Седамдесеторице» is the same claim. `types` UNTOUCHED: `apostle` from the heading, and `hieromartyr` from the body’s two facts together — he was made a bishop and «Обојица мученички скончаше за Христа Господа», both of them ended in martyrdom for Christ the Lord. The folder already held the compound grade off another source, so nothing was added; note that this is the SAME shape as `tertius` on the Julian 30 October, where the compound grade was REFUSED — the difference is that there the folder did not already hold it and the compound would have been mine to compose, while here it is the folder’s own and this book grounds it. `dates` UNTOUCHED: `death` 1 to 100, «1st century», off the Russian calendar’s «(I)» for the day’s apostles, and this entry gives no year. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS. HE TOO WORKED WITH ANDREW THE FIRST-CALLED AND WAS SET BISHOP BY HIM, and the see is given twice over: «у Лиди, или Диоспољу Јудејском» — at Lydda, or Diospolis of Judaea, which is the same city under its two names and which the folder carries as «Bishop of Diospolis». AND HE ENDED IN MARTYRDOM FOR CHRIST, together with Urban, in one sentence that covers the two of them. The folder already relates Andrew both ways. NO NEW `related`, no `locations`. THE FORM IS FREE: `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for «Амплије». The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Sfinţilor Apostoli, rugaţi pe Milostivul Dumnezeu, ca să dea iertare de greşeli sufletelor noastre.

source.text: doxologia.ro, Troparul Sfinților Apostoli Apelie, Stahie, Amplie, Urban, Aristobul și Narcis, Glasul 3

english.text: Holy Apostles, entreat the merciful God that he may grant our souls forgiveness of our offences.

hymns.text: Τὴν κιθάραν τοῦ Πνεύματος τὴν ἑξάχορδον, τὴν μελῳδήσασαν κόσμῳ τὰς ὑπὲρ νοῦν δωρεάς, ὡς ἐκφάντορας Χριστοῦ ἀνευφημήσωμεν, Στάχυν Ἀμπλίαν Ἀπελλῆν σὺν Ναρκίσσῳ Οὐρβανόν, καὶ Ἀριστόβουλον ἅμα· ὡς γὰρ Ἀπόστολοι θεῖοι, χάριν αἰτοῦνται ταῖς ψυχαῖς ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος πλ. α’, Τὸν συνάναρχον Λόγον — the second hymn on the page of the six. It names all six of them and no other saint.

english.text: Let us praise the six-stringed lyre of the Spirit, which sang to the world the gifts that are past understanding, as the revealers of Christ — Stachys, Amplias, Apelles with Narcissus, Urban, and Aristobulus together; for as divine Apostles they ask grace for our souls.

hymns.text: Ὡς ἱερὰ κειμήλια, τοῦ Παναγίου Πνεύματος, καὶ τοῦ Ἡλίου τῆς δόξης αὐγάσματα, χρεωστικῶς ὑμνήσωμεν, τοὺς σοφοὺς Ἀποστόλους, Ἀπελλῆν Οὐρβανόν τε καὶ Ἀριστόβουλον, Ἀμπλίαν Νάρκισσον καὶ Στάχυν, οὓς ἡ χάρις συνήγαγε τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος πλ. δ’, Ὡς ἀπαρχὰς τῆς φύσεως — on the page of the six. It names all six of them and no other saint.

english.text: As sacred treasures of the All-Holy Spirit and rays of the Sun of glory, let us hymn as we are bound the wise Apostles — Apelles and Urban and Aristobulus, Amplias, Narcissus and Stachys — whom the grace of our God gathered together.

hymns.text: Апостоли святии,/ молите Милостиваго Бога,/ да прегрешений оставление// подаст душам нашим.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 31 октября ст. ст. — «Тропарь апостолов». The text is the common of the apostles and names none of the six; it is the same text the Romanian page prints for the day, and it is copied whole, as the brief directs.

english.text: Holy apostles, pray to the merciful God that He may grant our souls forgiveness of our sins.

hymns.text: Яко священная сокровища Всесвятаго Духа/ и Солнца Славы сияния,/ по долгу воспоим мудрыя апостолы,/ Апеллия, Урвана же и Аристовула,/ Амплия, Наркисса и Стахия,// яже благодать собра Бога нашего.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 31 октября ст. ст. — «Кондак апостолов». It is the Slavonic of the Greek kontakion this folder already holds, and it names all six of the day's apostles.

english.text: As sacred treasuries of the All-Holy Spirit and rays of the Sun of Glory, let us sing as we ought of the wise apostles — Apelles, Urban and Aristobulus, Ampliatus, Narcissus and Stachys — whom the grace of our God gathered in.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 31 октября ст. ст. closes the six apostles with «(I)», and its life for them is titled with the same «(I)» — the first century. The folder held no `dates` before this; neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr dated him.
